description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
A customer under 18 years old cannot register.

cases.title: Register successfully with all required fields valid
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. The email address to be used (e.g. new.user1@example.com) is not registered in the system.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 01/05/1990).
cases.expected: The account is created; no validation errors are shown. (The exact confirmation wording is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Sign in with a newly registered account
cases.preconditions: An account has been created through the registration form with all required fields valid, using email new.user2@example.com and password Passw0rd123. The user is signed out.
cases.expected: The user is signed in with the newly created account.

cases.title: Registration with an already-registered email is rejected
cases.preconditions: An account already exists for email existing.user@example.com.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 12/03/1985).
Check in the system (e.g. admin/customer list) how many accounts exist for existing.user@example.com.
cases.expected: A clear error about the email already being registered is shown (exact wording not specified in the story), and no duplicate account is created — only the original account exists for that email.

cases.title: Invalid email format shows an inline validation error
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 01/05/1990).
Enter email: anna.novak(at)example (invalid format, no @ and no domain).
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the email field (exact wording not specified in the story) and the account is not created.

cases.title: Password below the minimum length shows an inline validation error
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. Email short.pwd@example.com is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 01/05/1990).
Enter password: Pass123 (7 characters, below the minimum of 8).
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the password field (exact wording not specified in the story) and the account is not created.

cases.title: Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. Email min.pwd@example.com is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 01/05/1990).
cases.expected: No password validation error is shown and the account is created (password must be at least 8 characters).

cases.title: Customer under 18 cannot register
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. Email teen.user@example.com is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer 16 years old today (today's date minus 16 years).
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and no account is created.

cases.title: Customer turning 18 exactly today can register
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. Email exactly18@example.com is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter date of birth: today's date minus exactly 18 years.
cases.expected: No age error is shown (the customer is not under 18) and the account is created.

cases.title: Customer one day before turning 18 cannot register
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. Email almost18@example.com is not registered. Today's date is known to the tester.
steps: Enter date of birth: today's date minus 18 years, plus one day (18th birthday is tomorrow).
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and no account is created.

cases.title: Submitting the form with a required field empty does not create an account
cases.preconditions: Registration page is reachable. Email missing.field@example.com is not registered.
steps: Enter date of birth: a date making the customer clearly over 18 (e.g. 01/05/1990).
Repeat the same submission leaving, in turn, last name empty, date of birth empty, email empty, and password empty.
cases.expected: In each case the account is not created, since the account is created only when all required fields (first name, last name, date of birth, email, password) are filled with valid data. (The exact message/behaviour for an empty required field is not specified in the story.)
